scope: Published direct-service defaults. Routed contracts and account settings can differ; neither residency nor zero retention is inferred from a host name.

services.label: OpenAI API
services.retention: Abuse-monitoring logs may include content and are normally kept up to 30 days, with safety/legal exceptions. Responses application state defaults to 30 days; approved ZDR and endpoint exceptions differ.
services.training: API content is not used for model training by default; opt-in sharing changes this.
services.regions: US and Europe support eligible regional processing. Other listed regions can provide storage only; eligibility, model snapshots and endpoints must be checked.

services.label: Anthropic API
services.retention: Inputs and outputs normally deleted within 30 days. Files, agreed retention, usage-policy enforcement and legal requirements are exceptions.
services.training: Commercial API inputs/outputs are not used for training by default. Opt-in feedback or data sharing can change this.
services.regions: Global inference is the default. US-only inference on supported Claude 4.6+ models costs 1.1× across token categories; workspace storage geography is separately configured (currently US).

services.label: Together direct inference
services.retention: Prompt/response storage is on by default. Organization admins can disable storage to enable ZDR; that also disables passthrough models.
services.training: Training data sharing is off by default and opt-in. Passthrough models follow their upstream provider's policy.
services.regions: Serverless has no region selector. Dedicated/private deployments can offer EU regions; availability and contract terms require confirmation.

services.label: Fireworks open-model inference
services.retention: Open-model prompt/generation content is not persistently logged by default, except explicit opt-in features. Responses API defaults to store=True and retains conversation state for 30 days; store=False disables that state storage.
services.training: No training-use guarantee has been separately reviewed here; consult the linked policy and account settings.
services.regions: A US-only serverless option is documented. Check model support and select the relevant endpoint; other route regions are unreported here.

services.label: OpenRouter routing
services.retention: Serving providers have separate retention policies. Route-level retention has not been verified in this card.
services.training: Account routing controls can exclude providers that train on prompts. Paid and free model policies can differ.
services.regions: Router access does not establish the serving region. Region constraints must be verified for the selected endpoint.
